fact: Djibouti's social affairs ministry, the national statistics institute INSTAD and World Bank experts began work to update the National Social Registry and revise its Proxy Means Test score.
title: Djibouti: Prise de contact entre le Ministère des affaires sociales, l'Instad et les experts de la Banque mondiale autour de l'actualisation du registre social et du score PNT.
